programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: The Crooked E: The Unshredded Truth About Enron
programme.desc: Once he starts working for the Enron Corporation, young trader Brian Cruver is quickly caught up in the company's obsession with greed and partying. When Enron suddenly files for bankruptcy, Cruver is swept up in the disastrous collapse.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Conclusion. Rich and powerful competitors try to destroy three Wyoming brothers as they struggle to survive in the cattle business.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Harder They Fall
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a crime-fighting sleuth with a double life. Jane Doe investigates the death of a high-powered business mogul. She quickly discovers that the man's apparent drowning was staged to look like an accident.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: Daryl Dixon finds himself in France after his departure from The Commonwealth, raising the wrath of a broken but growing tyrannical movement in Paris and endangering a boy at the center of a benevolent religious movement.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: Professor Thom Archer is convinced that the drilling by a corporate energy company, Halo, is having a devastating impact on the Greenland Glacier, one that will have dire consequences for mankind. In the year 2020, global warming has had a profound impact on the world, transforming much of Europe into desert, with only the United Kingdom and the United States seemingly unaffected by a devastating rain drought. When Professor Archer visits the Arctic to prove his theory, he realizes the entirety of the planet is under serious threat, and races home to save the ones he loves, and anyone else who will listen. Science-fiction mini series.

One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Now You See It, Now You Don't
programme.desc: Mystery thriller starring Lea Thompson ('Back to the Future') as an undercover agent who investigates the theft of the Declaration of Independence from a Los Angeles bank. When her prime suspect is murdered, she finds herself taking on a master of deceit.

programme.title: Just a Dream
programme.desc: Film crew arrives in a small town in Nevada desert. Ends up changing the life of a 12-year-old kid and a friend of his, a movie lover.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a British TV drama series revolving around a corrupt council official who used to be an idealistic young man. Every new day brings him a new blackout because of alcohol, and sufferings to his family for the same reason. One day he gets his breath and realises he has become a murderer. He wants to tell his dark secret to his lawyer and goes to the court. There he becomes a witness of a shooting and covers an important witness with his own body. He becomes a local hero and people want to see him as the next mayor. He begins a dramatic quest for redemption.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: A young woman on her way to a new life in the 1800s suddenly becomes a widow and must live with a recently-widowed young man and his daughter. Can any of them find love again?

programme.title: Prayers For Bobby
programme.desc: Emotional drama based on a true story. In 1970s America, a deeply devout mother finds her religious beliefs shaken when she learns that her son is gay. She urges her son to devote his time to the church in the hope that it will cure him of his 'sin', but the boy's increasing isolation leads to a tragic outcome. The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Mystery spy thriller about a housewife who leads a double life as an undercover government agent. When a major arms dealer stages an ingenious escape froman LA prison and sets out on a mission of vengeance, Jane Doe faces a race against time to protect the intended victim.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A man begins to have disturbing visions of dead people. All telling their story of how they died, and how their murderer is still out there. The detective investigating the murders looks to him for help in solving the case.

programme.title: Talking to Heaven
programme.desc: A medium and a detective join forces to uncover the identities of seven boys who have been murdered.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Cathy and Frank partner with a beautiful insurance investigator in the recovery of stolen art. Frank is smitten with her, even though it becomes more apparent she may be the mastermind behind the theft.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Jasper, Texas
programme.desc: In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.title: Family Gathering Aka You Lucky Dog
programme.desc: Sentimental romantic comedy starring Natasha Henstridge and Harry Hamlin. After her mother's death, a New York City fashion designer returns to her hometown and the family sheep farm.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: Historical drama with Patrick Stewart. In 1183, after the death of his eldest son, King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Amazonia
programme.desc: The world's greatest rainforest is home to nearly half the world's species. Life-and-death dramas unfold in this most precarious of habitats, more than 100 feet above the forest floor, as Harpy eagles carry off full-grown monkeys.

programme.title: Amazonia
programme.desc: The boto dolphin and the giant otter are some of the inhabitants of lagoons and flooded forests. In this world, the Amazon rushes then recedes as the rainforest's terrestrial and aquatic realms battle for dominance.

programme.title: Amazonia
programme.desc: Predator Playground. Reveals a new world teeming with predators. Stealthy jaguars prowl, army ants swarm and tarantulas bring down rodent prey as 2.5 million square miles of rain forest emerge from the folds.

programme.title: Amazonia

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Ultimate Rivals: Cats vs Dogs
programme.desc: Canines and felines have been living side by side in Africa for hundreds of thousands of years, and they've never really gotten along-not even amongst themselves. Throw the hyena into the mix and they're all nightmare neighbors? Stealing from each other; harassing each other; eating each other's young. Avoidance might be the only way to stay alive. Cats, dogs and the wild-card hyena, all jousting in a free for all for survival.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: Discover some of the most dangerous and deadly animal species on the planet, from big cats to tiny insects. These creatures developed amazing skills to survive and kill their pray in unique ways. Some of them use poison as their main weapon, while others are incredibly fast or camouflage well in order to catch their victims.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: India's Wild Leopards
programme.desc: India may be the land of the Tiger, but it is also home to masters of stealth that prowl the deepest of jungles and the highest of mountains. Journey to Ladakh in the Himalaya in search of Snow Leopards - the ghost of the mountains. Then venture into the realm of the smallest of big cats - the Clouded Leopard in the jungles of north east India. Wildlife Cameraman and National Geographic Fellow, Sandesh Kadur is on a mission to uncover their secretive lives.

programme.title: Jade Eyed Leopard
programme.desc: We follow Toto, a sea-green-eyed leopard during the first year of her life, as she learns the vital skills to survive.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Max calls on the Midknights to testify on Mumblin's behalf. When those attempts fail, Max takes the stand. Max must battle the Worms of Justice and if she wins, then Mumblin will be set free. Transported to a desert, Max battles giant worms. In the end, Max defeats the worms and Mumblin wins his trial. Unfortunately, the Midknights are sent back to their boat, which is headed straight for a massive waterfall!

programme.desc: When the Midknights' ship is set off course, the team must survive treacherous new waters. Before Max can enact her plan, she is summoned to Wizard Court where Mumblin is on trial for his life. Max must help Mumblin prove that he is a good wizard and that he escaped the afterlife to help the Midknights defeat Fendra. If Max can't, Mumblin will be sent away for good. Max calls on the Midknights to testify on Mumblin's behalf. When those attempts fail, Max takes the stand. At first, Max's emotional testimony seems to win over the court, but her pleas for Mumblin's freedom backfire and Mumblin is ultimately found guilty. Luckily, Kevyn discovers a way to save Mumblin. Max must battle the Worms of Justice and if she wins, then Mumblin will be set free. Transported to a desert, Max battles giant worms. In the end, Max defeats the worms and Mumblin wins his trial. Unfortunately, the Midknights are sent back to their boat, which is headed straight for a massive waterfall!

programme.title: Rosa Elettrica - In fuga con il nemico

programme.title: Rosa Elettrica - In fuga con il nemico
programme.desc: Rosa è decisa a proseguire l'indagine, ma insieme a Cociss deve recuperare un indizio fondamentale. Insieme devono superare una missione impossibile.

programme.desc: Un grande cast italiano per il nuovo successo di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni. Due coppie in crisi affrontano un viaggio a Tangeri che cambierà ogni equilibrio.

programme.desc: Richard Gere ed Edward Norton, premiato con il Golden Globe, in un classico thriller giudiziario. Un avvocato accetta di difendere gratis un chierichetto, un giovane schizofrenico affetto da personalita' multipla, accusato dell'omicidio dell'arcivescovo di Chicago. Le prove dell'accusa contro il ragazzo sono schiaccianti, ma la partita in tribunale e' tutta da giocare, anche perche' la verita' e' molto piu' complessa e sorprendente. E soprattutto non e' quella che sembra. Film d'esordio per Norton, che ottenne anche la nomination agli Oscar come miglior attore non protagonista.

programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.desc: In Iran un uomo incontra per caso una persona che ritiene essere stata il suo torturatore. L'uomo nega strenuamente di essere coinvolto nella faccenda, cosa che insospettisce ancora di più chi lo ha riconosciuto.

programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: Un Semplice Incidente

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Quella sporca ultima meta
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds nel classico del genere carcerario di Robert Aldrich. In prigione per guida in stato di ebbrezza, un ex campione di rugby viene costretto ad allenare una squadra di detenuti.

programme.desc: Una delle pellicole piu' celebri di Nanni Moretti premiata a Cannes per la miglior regia. 3 capitoli di un'autobiografia collettiva: le ossessioni del regista si fondono con quelle del paese.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.title: Giulio Regeni: Tutto il male del mondo

Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

Il bottino non e' mai stato recuperato, ma il suo vecchio socio e' convinto che Will sappia dove sia finito. E per recuperarlo ha un solo modo per convincerlo a collaborare: rapisce sua figlia Allison e la tiene prigioniera nel bagagliaio di un taxi. Se vuole rivedere la ragazza sana e salva, Will deve trovare 10 milioni di dollari in 12 ore.

programme.desc: Il premio Oscar 2023 Brendan Fraser nel primo capitolo di una saga avventurosa. Un gruppo di esploratori risveglia la salma di un sacerdote egizio colpito da un'antica maledizione.

programme.desc: Guy Pearce e Stephen Lang in un horror satanico. Un esperto esorcista conduce un giovane sacerdote nel mondo delle possessioni demoniache in un terrificante percorso di iniziazione.

programme.title: Allied - Un'ombra nascosta
programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.title: Inside Man: Most Wanted
programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapina la banca federale americana, dando inizio a un sequestro di dieci ore. Un esperto di negoziazione e un agente federale collaborano per salvare gli ostaggi e impedire la rapina.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Naomi Watts in un thriller carico di suspense. Una psicologa infantile, vedova e con un figliastro paralizzato da accudire, affronta il caso della misteriosa sparizione di un bambino.

programme.title: L'ombra del dubbio
programme.desc: Un uomo si trasferisce presso dei parenti: la nipote si invaghisce di lui, ma presto si rende conto che potrebbe essere lui il killer ricercato dalla polizia... Capolavoro di suspance del re del brivido.

programme.title: Hai mai avuto paura?
programme.desc: Una bestia sanguinaria imperversa nelle notti di luna piena nell'horror di Ambra Principato, ispirato a un romanzo di Michele Mari.

programme.title: Nella morsa del ragno
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman in un thriller di Lee Tamahori. Un esperto criminologo e una giovane agente indagano sul rapimento della figlia di un senatore, giungendo a una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: Miss Sloane - Giochi di potere
programme.desc: John Madden dirige Jessica Chastain nei panni di un'impetuosa eroina della verita'. Una lobbista deve contrastare una proposta di legge sul controllo delle armi. Passera' al fronte opposto.

programme.title: La ragazza del treno
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Paula Hawkins, thriller con Emily Blunt e Rebecca Ferguson. Una donna sviluppa una morbosa curiosita' nei confronti del suo ex e viene coinvolta in un caso misterioso.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Naomi Watts in un thriller carico di suspense. Una psicologa infantile, vedova e con un figliastro paralizzato da accudire, affronta il caso della misteriosa sparizione di un bambino.

programme.desc: Carlo Lavagna dirige un thriller ambientato nel buio dei boschi. Una madre severa costringe le figlie a vivere da recluse in un hotel abbandonato per proteggerle da una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: I peccatori
programme.desc: Nel delta del Mississippi per un vampire movie con Michael B. Jordan e Hailee Steinfeld. 1932: due gemelli afroamericani dal passato travagliato tornano nella città natale per aprire un night club per la comunità nera locale, ma devono affrontare un nemico terrificante.

programme.title: Rinascita
programme.desc: La vita perfetta di una donna viene sconvolta dal ritorno di un'ombra malevola del suo passato, che la costringe a confrontarsi con il mostro che ha eluso per due decenni della sua vita.

programme.desc: La paura sbuca dagli abissi nell'horror di Alexandre Bustillo e Julien Maury. Una giovane coppia in cerca di luoghi misteriosi scopre l'esistenza di uno spaventoso mondo sommerso.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: Andy Muschietti dirige il primo capitolo horror tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. un gruppo di ragazzini si allea per sconfiggere il malvagio clown colpevole delle sparizioni di bambini.

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: Anthony Mackie e Jamie Dornan in un fanta-thriller allucinato. New Orleans: una droga sintetica conduce chi ne fa uso dentro un incubo spaventoso. Un paramedico decide di sperimentare la sostanza su di sé, finendo per vagare in una realtà totalmente alterata.

programme.title: Songbird
programme.desc: Prodotto da Michael Bay, un thriller che immagina un drammatico futuro. 2024: le continue mutazioni del Covid-19 hanno chiuso il mondo in un eterno lockdown. In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: They Talk
programme.desc: Fenomeni paranormali nell'horror di Giorgio Bruno. Durante la realizzazione di un documentario, un tecnico del suono registra voci spaventose provenienti dall'Aldilà. Insieme a una vecchia amica tenterà di capirne il significato, mentre macabri eventi lo perseguitano.

programme.title: La ragazza del treno
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Paula Hawkins, thriller con Emily Blunt e Rebecca Ferguson. Una donna sviluppa una morbosa curiosita' nei confronti del suo ex e viene coinvolta in un caso misterioso.

programme.desc: Meraviglia e suspense con Hugh Jackman e Christian Bale, per la regia di Christopher Nolan. La Londra di fine 800 fa da sfondo all'accesa e ossessiva rivalita' tra due illusionisti.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: Pallottole e droga nella Marsiglia degli anni 70 in un action con il premio Oscar Jean Dujardin. Un temerario giudice conduce un'ostinata battaglia contro un padrino della malavita.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky tratto dall'omonima graphic novel. Sola nel deserto, una donna deve liberare il figlio intrappolato in una macchina blindata.

programme.desc: Ari Aster ("Hereditary") dirige Florence Pugh in un insolito horror alla luce del sole. In un villaggio svedese, una coppia di fidanzati viene coinvolta in sanguinari riti pagani.

programme.desc: James Wan dirige Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel secondo capitolo della saga horror. I coniugi Warren cercano di proteggere una famiglia dagli spiriti che infestano la loro casa londinese.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Thriller psicologico con Sarah Paulson e Keira Allen. Costretta su una sedia a rotelle, la giovane Chloe scopre che le amorevoli cure di sua madre nascondono una verita' inaspettata.

programme.desc: Pallottole e droga nella Marsiglia degli anni 70 in un action con il premio Oscar Jean Dujardin. Un temerario giudice conduce un'ostinata battaglia contro un padrino della malavita.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: Demeter - Il risveglio di Dracula
programme.desc: Horror claustrofobico ispirato al romanzo di Bram Stoker. 1897: una nave mercantile russa viene trovata abbandonata e il diario di bordo svelerà i tremendi fatti avvenuti.

programme.title: Armi chimiche
programme.desc: Ben Kingsley e Monica Bellucci in uno spy-thriller. Una donna avvenente e fatale complica i piani di un anziano agente del Mossad, alle prese con l'ultima missione della sua vita.

programme.title: Suburra
programme.desc: Pierfrancesco Favino, Elio Germano, Claudio Amendola e Alessandro Borghi nel noir di Stefano Sollima. Tra corruzione dilagante e malavita si consuma la feroce lotta per il potere a Roma.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova analizzano la serie Downton Abbey.

programme.title: A Quiet Place - Un posto tranquillo
programme.desc: John Krasinski dirige e interpreta l'horror rivelazione con Emily Blunt. Una famiglia e' costretta a vivere senza fare alcun rumore per salvarsi dai mostri che hanno invaso la Terra.

programme.title: L'uomo invisibile
programme.desc: Elisabeth Moss in un horror targato Blumhouse che rispolvera il personaggio creato da H.G. Wells. Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.title: La legge della notte
programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.title: In fondo al bosco
programme.desc: Prodotto da Sky Cinema, un thriller di Stefano Lodovichi. Tommi scompare durante una festa. Anni dopo viene ritrovato un bambino con lo stesso DNA ma la madre non lo riconosce.

programme.title: The Hanging Sun - Sole di mezzanotte
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jo Nesbo, Sky Original di Francesco Carrozzini con Alessandro Borghi. In fuga verso l'estremo Nord, John conosce Lea e Caleb, unica speranza di salvezza da un destino segnato.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Drop: Accetta o rifiuta
programme.desc: Una donna accetta un appuntamento romantico, ma la serata sprofonda nell'incubo quando un anonimo criminale comincia a perseguitarla: sul suo smartphone arrivano messaggi sempre piu' minacciosi e un terrificante ricatto a cui lei non puo' sottrarsi.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: Christopher Abbott e Julia Garner in un horror targato Blumhouse. Nei boschi dell'Oregon con moglie e figlia, Blake viene morso da una bestia feroce. I tre si rifugiano in casa, e mentre l'animale si aggira nei dintorni, Blake inizia a trasformarsi in qualcosa di non umano.

programme.title: Occhiali neri
programme.desc: Dario Argento torna alla regia di un horror con Ilenia Pastorelli e Asia Argento. In una Roma immersa nelle tenebre, una escort non vedente finisce nel mirino di un serial killer.

programme.title: Detective Marlowe
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original di Neil Jordan con Liam Neeson, Diane Kruger e Jessica Lange. Hollywood, anni 30: il detective Marlowe e' incaricato di ritrovare l'ex amante di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda guidano un cast di superstar hollywoodiane in una commedia spensierata sulla riscoperta della sessualita'. Quattro amiche che da tantissimi anni amano discutere di libri, decidono di calarsi nella lettura di uno dei fenomeni letterari del ventunesimo secolo: il famigerato romanzo erotico "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio". Scorrere quelle pagine piccanti, sviscerarne ogni dettaglio non le lascera' affatto indifferenti ma le spingera' ad assecondare le loro piu' capricciose curiosita', cogliendo l'occasione per dare una svolta alla loro routine.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: 7 Oscar e Orso d'argento a Berlino a un'epica love story con Gwyneth Paltrow e un grande cast. Londra, 1593. In crisi creativa, Shakespeare trova l'ispirazione grazie all'amore per Viola.

programme.title: One for the Money
programme.desc: Divertente commedia con la star di "Grey's Anatomy" Katherine Heigl. Fresca di divorzio, Stephanie si ritrova senza lavoro a vivere in compagnia del suo criceto. Accetta così di diventare cacciatrice di taglie, per rintracciare quelle persone che devono dei soldi al cugino. Il suo primo incarico è ritrovare un ex poliziotto accusato di omicidio che, guarda il caso, ai tempi del liceo le aveva spezzato il cuore. Grazie all'aiuto di un collega riuscirà a farsi strada in un mondo decisamente maschile. La Heigl è anche produttrice del film.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Always - Per sempre
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg firma una romantica commedia soprannaturale con Richard Dreyfuss e Holly Hunter. Morto in un incidente aereo, un pilota accetta di fare da angelo custode alla fidanzata.

programme.title: Il dottor Zivago
programme.desc: 5 Oscar alla storia d'amore fra Omar Sharif e Julie Christie, dal romanzo di Pasternak. Sullo sfondo della Rivoluzione russa, un medico si innamora perdutamente di un'infermiera.

programme.title: Le cose non dette
programme.desc: Un grande cast italiano per il nuovo successo di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni. Due coppie in crisi affrontano un viaggio a Tangeri che cambierà ogni equilibrio.

programme.title: We Live In Time - Tutto il tempo che abbiamo
programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Andrew Garfield sono i protagonisti di una toccante storia d’amore. Dopo un incidente, Tobias e Almut vivranno un'intensa relazione tra momenti di felicità e dolore.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.title: Mia moglie è un fantasma
programme.desc: Brillante commedia con Dan Stevens, Leslie Mann, Isla Fisher e Judi Dench basata sull’omonimo racconto. Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi

L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: Tutte lo vogliono
programme.desc: Enrico Brignano, Ilaria Spada e Vanessa Incontrada nella commedia degli equivoci di Alessio Maria Federici. Un imbranato shampista per cani viene scambiato per un rinomato gigolo'.

programme.title: Ex - Amici come prima!
programme.desc: Commedia corale di Carlo Vanzina con Alessandro Gassmann ed Enrico Brignano in un intreccio di storie d'amore clandestine e ritorni di fiamma tra architetti, avvocati e psicanalisti.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - A bocce ferme
programme.desc: Nuove indagini a Pineta nel 18esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre i vecchini aiutano Massimo e la Fusco, Beppe e Tiziana cercano di ritagliarsi del tempo da soli.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Omicidio a Los Angeles
programme.desc: Eccentrica commedia Sky Original con Mel Gibson e Charlie Hunnam. Un ex poliziotto lascia la sua casa nel bosco per indagare su un delitto di cui è stato accusato un divo della tv.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.
